title: The Uplift: Road trips and homecomings
summary: A grandmother and her grandson set out on a quest to visit all 93 U.S. national parks – and find joy on the road. A toddler who spent the first 1,000 days of his life in the hospital reaches a milestone. A man wades in floodwaters to save his mother after Hurricane Ian. Plus, our heartwarming videos you just need to see.
